dimensions.assessment: Imposes background check access for contractors and credentialed individuals, altering hiring and vetting protocols.
dimensions.evidence: is employed by, contracts with, or seeks to be employed by or contract with, an entity that is under contract with a qualified entity

dimensions.assessment: Does not specify federal expenditures, though administrative processing costs for background checks may be incurred by applicants or entities.
Amends the National Child Protection Act of 1993 to broaden the definition of covered individuals for federal background check systems.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the National Child Protection Act of 1993 to ensure that businesses and organizations that work with vulnerable populations are able to request background checks

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to background check eligibility criteria nationwide.

missing_information: Estimated fees or administrative processing workloads for handling contractor and licensing background checks.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands background check eligibility under the National Child Protection Act of 1993 to cover contractors and licensed or certified individuals working with vulnerable populations.

latest_action.text: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 23 - 0.

card.title: To amend the National Child Protection Act of 1993 to ensure that businesses and organizations that work with vulnerable populations are able to request background checks for their contractors who work with those populations, as well as for individuals that the businesses or organizations license or certify to provide care for those populations.
